run_convex_decomposition: run the CLI tool to decompose object meshes into convex parts for a dataset task
run_decompose_with_floor: run the decomposition tool with add_floor flag to flatten the base of convex parts
run_decompose_single_hand: run the decomposition tool for a single hand embodiment type like right or left
create_voxel_convex_hulls: create convex hulls from a point cloud by clustering points into voxel grids
create_flattened_base_plate: create a thin plate mesh that flattens the bottom of a convex decomposition
